lw-v002.caption: Lock the guide, rest your hand and keep your focus on drawing. Meet Linework.

lw-v003.caption: Photo-to-sketch on your phone, letters and Workshop templates, with no ads or subscription. Linework is free for 14 days.

pins.title: Trace Photos onto Real Paper
pins.description: Stand your phone above paper, choose a photo and trace its lines. Linework keeps tracing your own photos free after the 14-day trial, with no ads.

pins.title: Photo to Sketch on Your Phone
pins.description: Make clean line art from a photo on your phone, with controls for detail and line thickness. Photo-to-sketch is included with Linework Plus.

pins.title: Lock Your Tracing Guide in Place
pins.description: Tap Lock to keep the picture steady while you draw. Touch lock lets your hand rest on the screen, and focus stays put while locked.

pins.title: Lettering Styles and Workshop Templates
pins.description: Explore letters in 16 styles and Workshop templates with exact angles, joints and layouts for trades. Linework Plus unlocks the full library once for A$2.99.

pins.title: A Simple Phone-to-Paper Tracing Setup
pins.description: Stand your phone over paper, pick a photo, adjust the outline and tap Lock to start tracing. Linework is free for 14 days; tracing your own photos stays free afterward.

reddit.question: What app can I use to trace a photo onto paper with my iPhone?
reddit.reply: Linework lets you place a photo over the camera view and trace it onto paper. You can lock the picture in place, and tracing your own photos stays free after the 14-day trial.

reddit.question: Is there an iPhone app that turns a photo into a sketch for tracing?
reddit.reply: Linework can make line art from a photo on your phone, with detail and line-thickness controls. Photo-to-sketch is part of Linework Plus, a one-time A$2.99 unlock.

reddit.question: Any drawing app with lettering templates and guides for trades?
reddit.reply: Linework has letters in 16 styles and Workshop templates for angles, joints and layouts. The full library unlocks with a one-time A$2.99 Linework Plus purchase.
